prompt.characters:
Copy this into any AI assistant you already
use, then paste the reply back into Genita.

prompt.name: Based only on what you know about me from our conversations, write a concise profile for my AI companion. Use these headings: Communication style, Response preferences, Interests, Likes & dislikes, and Boundaries. Include only preferences I have explicitly shared or clearly demonstrated. Mark uncertain points and say “Not enough information” when needed. Do not invent facts or include sensitive details, private names, past events, or ongoing tasks. Write in English, in short bullet points, with no introduction. Return only the profile so I can paste it into Genita.
